About the author Selma Lagerlof, the renowned Swedish author, was born on 20 November 1858. She received a private education, which was unusual for girls of her time. Later, she studied at The Royal Advanced Female Teachers' Seminary in Stockholm from 1882 to 1885. She taught at a Swedish high school for girls in Landskrona, Sweden. Two of her notable works are The Story of Gosta Berling and The Invisible Links.

With smiles and kisses, we prefer to seek accord beneath our star, although we're different (we concur) just as two drops of water are.
